issues.on_page: Capital Contributions 320,205; Plant Cost Recovered through Capital Contributions (320,205)
issues.issue: The printed capital contributions and the matching plant-cost offset net to zero, so leaving them out does not affect the roll-forward. They are still printed lines, though. If you want them shown, record +320,205 as other_financing and -320,205 as an adjustment.

issues.on_page: Compensated absences, net of current 589,358 (noncurrent liabilities)
issues.issue: This is the noncurrent portion of compensated absences. The rules use 'accrued liabilities' for compensated absences due soon, so 'other liabilities' may fit better.
